content.text: I have inspected every candidate location and searched independently for restrictions binding our party.

input.quote: Harpoon shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to (a) directly or indirectly, develop, commercialize or otherwise exploit any Competing Product in any country or other jurisdiction in the Territory
input.rationale: The only exclusivity covenant in the Agreement (Section 5.8) binds Harpoon and its Affiliates, not AbbVie; Section 5.6.1 confirms Harpoon's retained rights are "subject to Section 5.8", and Section 7.2 refers to "in the case of Harpoon, its exclusivity obligations hereunder". That restriction runs in our favour and is not flagged. Searches for reciprocal covenants ("AbbVie shall not", "AbbVie may not", "neither Party shall", "directly or indirectly", "Competing Product") return no non-compete, field-of-use or territory covenant binding AbbVie: Article 4 gives AbbVie sole Commercialization rights, Section 10.4 (Covenants of AbbVie) contains only an IP-assignment covenant, and Article 12 imposes no post-termination competition restraint. The licence scope in Section 5.1.3 (Field/Territory) is a grant boundary, not a covenant restricting our business. This sits at the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
